changes: New: Subject swap. Trade a registered subject with another student, on the website and in the apps
Post the subject you have and the one you want, and swaps that match yours show first
A student's phone and email show only to signed-in students who open their swap
ASU Bank is now UniHub, with a new name and a new icon
This update installs as a new app: sign in once, then you can delete the old ASU Bank app
Send disappearing voice messages, photos and videos in rooms and private messages
Posts can have a voice message or a video too
Choose when something disappears: after 1 minute, 60 minutes, 1 day or 1 week
See who saw your story, with the exact date and time
Delete for everyone removes a message on both sides
Messages, comments and friend requests now show at once, and posts and stories upload in the background
New loading effects everywhere, smoother and less waiting
A new story screen with more fonts, text effects, colors, gradient backgrounds and moving text
A new look for posting a video story, with your video playing while you edit
Share UniHub with your friends from More
Changing the theme now restarts the app, so the new colors always load cleanly
Feed now has Friends, Strangers and Guest
Read public posts and stories without an account, also on the website
Choose who sees each new post or story: everyone, ASU students or friends
Swipe sideways on the Feed to open the camera for a photo or video story, at 60 FPS when your phone can
Private messages between friends, with photos, PDF and Word files
A new look for the chat
Weather is back at the top of Home, and the banner and search box are smaller
Sharper cover photos and a cleaner star on admin photos
New Feed: posts with photos, comments and likes from everyone or just your friends
Stories: share a photo or text for 24 hours
Add a cover photo to your profile
Hold anyone's photo to see it bigger
Calendar, next lecture and your exams now come first on Home
New Exams & tasks list and a Focus timer
6 new backgrounds and 6 new accent colors
Who's online now lists every registered student, with search
Fixes: sharper profile photos, and the online row shows only people who are online
See what changed after every update, and every past version under More > What's New
Changing the app icon now works when the app is installed with TrollStore
Home can show a sponsor card, always clearly labelled
The About text now says how UniHub is supported: ads on the website, sponsors and donations
New Notifications tab: friend requests, pokes, new uploads, announcements and admin requests in one list
Suggest materials is now a real form in the app, saved in the same place as the website's form
Admins: delete any file from Drive by holding it, and it stays gone after a refresh
Friends, Users and the admin screens open much faster
More: see how our files are spread across the colleges
Fixed the star and online dot on profile photos
iPhone: fixed rows and buttons that greyed when tapped but wouldn't open, on iOS 15 and 16
iPhone: changing the app icon is fixed, and if iOS refuses, the message now says why
The weather card shows the exact day and date, plus the day's high and low
Android: neater official links, including the alumni platform
Fixed: settings under More sometimes wouldn't open or froze
Faster: the app starts quicker, and lists and photos scroll more smoothly
Upload is rebuilt as a native screen with no limit on file size or number of files; a dropped connection picks up where it stopped
Report any file: hold it in a list, or use the menu when it's open
Choose your app icon under More > App icon
Early supporter badge for everyone who joins by the end of November 2026, with our thanks
A neater owner star on profile photos
New shortcut: the university's alumni platform
Friends: add classmates, accept requests, poke them or ask to meet, study or grab coffee, and share posts in a new Friends tab
Bigger profiles with a cover, counts, year, interests and posts
My lectures: add the subject, hall and time, and get a reminder 10 minutes before
Campus weather on Home, from 7 AM till 4 PM
Choose your notification sounds, and which tabs are in your tab bar
Life hacks: first aid, safety, studying, exams and saving money, plus 911 one tap away
Book a photoshoot and add your group's link right in the app; the owner accepts or rejects groups in Admin
Student submissions: upload the file itself instead of a link
7 more themes
Report anything: press and hold a chat message, open a profile, or use the menu on any file to report it. Anyone can report a problem from More, even without an account.
Block people: you won't see their messages or get notifications from them. Undo it any time from your account.
Community rules and a privacy policy, both in More.
Safer chat: abusive words are filtered, and deleting your account removes your name from your old messages.
Search help: type a course in Arabic or English, even with mistakes. The app translates it, suggests the right word and subject, and searches both languages.
Major and college on your profile, set in Edit profile and shown to other students.
More badges, such as Mentor, Top student, Class rep, Translator and Legend.
Arabic everywhere: the student guide, FAQs, shortcuts, halls, rules and every other page now switch to Arabic, not only the buttons. Material names stay as they were uploaded.
Tabs fixed: tap a tab you are already in, like More, to go back to its first page.
Profiles: add a profile photo, a line about yourself and your phone number (shown only if you choose). Tap anyone in the chat to see their profile, call them or open WhatsApp.
Who's online: see who is online right now and when others were last seen, with a green dot on their photo.
Edit your messages after sending them (they show "edited").
Choose your notifications: chat messages, replies to you, announcements and new uploads, each on or off, and mute the rooms you don't want.
Special badges such as Helper, Support, Donor, Tutor and Verified, given by the team, shown on profiles and in the chat.
Language: English, Arabic, Spanish or your phone's language, in More > Language.
Rate our service and the Discord voting are now native screens, and they count together with the website.
For admins: add, rename, reorder, lock, archive, clear and delete chat rooms, pin a message to the top of a room, and give or remove badges.
Notifications now also cover replies to you and new uploads. On iPhone they arrive when iOS lets the app check in the background.
Accounts: sign in or create an account with just a username and password (university email and ID are optional). The same account works in the iPhone app, the Android app and on asubank.org.
Student chat: real-time rooms (General, Study help, Materials and more) where signed-in students help each other. Reply to messages, copy them, and delete your own.
Notifications for new messages ("New message from …") and team announcements. Pick every message, announcements only, or off.
Themes: match your phone, Light, Dark, or Pitch black for OLED screens, plus 7 accent colors.
Student submissions, now native: browse the board, search it and submit your presentation from the app.
The UniHub logo greets you for a moment when the app opens. Upload is now a sheet you can open from anywhere.
When a new version is out, the app tells you as soon as you open it.
Enhanced Thanks list with stats and a founder card.
For admins: an Admin tab to see every registered student, ban or unban, reset passwords, make admins, delete accounts, delete chat messages and uploads, send announcements and see the activity log.
Course matcher, now native: fill in your courses, topics and free times on a simple grid, and get matched with classmates by email.
Request a material, now native: pick a service, attach your PDF, choose CliQ (alias ALANQ99) or in-person payment, and send it from the app.
Your uploads show up in Latest uploads right away, together with the newest files in the shared upload folder.
Grading scale redesigned, with a term average and cumulative average calculator.
How to search guide rewritten for the app: try a search right from the guide.
WhatsApp groups & resources: grouped by college and year, searchable, one tap to join.
New Thanks list, Student ads and Support UniHub screens. CliQ now uses the alias ALANQ99 (Bank of Jordan).
Teacher ratings connect more reliably.
Rate your teachers, now fully native: search every rated teacher, sort by top rated or most votes, see averages out of 10 with color bars, and rate anyone in a few taps. Still 100% anonymous.
University halls finder: type the number on a hall's door (e.g. 1206) and see the building, floor and room instantly, in English and Arabic.
Works on iOS 15 and newer, so it now runs on every iPhone from the iPhone 6s up.
Fixed Google Drive folders that looked empty: every file inside a folder now shows up.
Search no longer shows the same file several times.
asubank.org links shared with you open straight in the app.
Every material opens natively: PDFs in a built-in PDF reader, slides, documents and sheets in Quick Look, and Google Drive folders as native lists you can browse and search.
Fixed files that showed "No preview available" (Google Drive shortcuts now open the real file or folder).
Dead or private links are hidden. If you open one from Saved, you can request it instead.
Opened files are kept offline; More > Storage shows the size and clears the cache.
